country.name: Lesotho

acts.title: Penal Code Act, 2012
acts.label: Act 6 of 2012
decisions: Penal Code: in force 2012-03-09, the day of its publication in Government Gazette 30 (LesLII coverpage), under its s. 1: it "shall come into operation on the date of its publication in the Gazette". The Act cites itself as the Penal Code Act, 2010 (s. 1, as printed); LesLII files it as Act 6 of 2012.
Penal Code: LesLII's History lists no amendment after commencement (archived copy of 2026-01-12); the one version is the Act as published.

acts.title: Children's Protection and Welfare Act, 2011
acts.label: Act 7 of 2011
decisions: Children's Protection and Welfare Act: in force 2011-03-31, the day of its publication in Government Gazette 40, the commencement LesLII states. LesLII lists no amendment.

acts.title: Arbitration Act, 1980
acts.label: Act 12 of 1980
decisions: Arbitration Act: dated 1981-10-01, the commencement LesLII's coverpage states ("Commenced on 1 October 1981"); LesLII links the commencement to the Pension Scheme (Corporate Bodies) Act, 1979, which is how its page reads, not a sourced commencement instrument. LesLII lists no amendment.

ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and the Constitution parser and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
